title: Maximum Product After K Increments
goal: Maximize the product after exactly k increments of individual values.
strategy: For two values a no larger than b, incrementing a produces at least as large a product as incrementing b. Repeatedly increment the current minimum with a heap, then multiply modulo one billion plus seven.
